page.heading: Skills

empty.title: No skills yet
empty.body: Create a skill or import one from a .md / .zip file. Skills are plain Markdown instructions — nothing is executed.

selectPrompt.title: Select a skill
selectPrompt.body: Pick a skill on the left to preview its body.

page.runOnEvalsHint: L06 — evals arrive in a later lesson
page.unsavedConfirm: You have unsaved changes to this skill. Discard them?

drawer.title: Add a skill
drawer.subtitle: Import from a file, a URL, or search vetted community skills

file.nameHint: Optional — derived from the first heading if blank.
file.bodyHint: Pasted content is wrapped as untrusted data — never executed as instructions.

url.label: Skill URL
url.hint: Fetched server-side, stored as untrusted, and left disabled until vetted.
url.success: Imported "{name}". Disabled until you vet + enable it.

preview.untrustedNotice: Imported skills are someone else’s instructions that will run inside your agent’s prompt. Review before saving.
preview.bodyHint: Saving a changed body creates a new immutable version.

stub.title: Coming in {lesson}
stub.body: This tab is part of a later lesson and is not available yet.

config.title: Configuration
config.name: Name
config.nameHint: Lowercase kebab-case (a–z, 0–9, -), 2–63 characters. Used as the skill identifier.
config.descriptionPlaceholder: Flag new branches and error paths that have no test covering them.
config.descriptionHint: Describe when the agent should apply this skill — write it as an instruction, e.g. "Flag …"

errors.nameFormat: Use lowercase letters, digits and dashes (2–63 chars, must start with a letter or digit).
errors.nameTaken: A skill with this name already exists.
errors.bodyTooLong: Skill body must be at most 20,000 characters.

editor.tokensHint: Approximate (characters ÷ 4). The exact count is shown in the run trace.

previewTab.title: Preview
previewTab.hint: Rendered as the reviewing agent receives it.

versions.title: Version history
versions.hint: Every save snapshots the body so eval runs stay reproducible against the exact text they scored.
versions.restoreConfirm: Restore v{version}? This creates a new version with its content — history is kept.

diff.title: v{from} → current (v{to})
diff.subtitle: Lines removed since v{from} are red, added lines are green.

import.title: Import skill
import.subtitle: Upload a .md file or a .zip containing SKILL.md. Nothing is saved until you confirm.
import.fileHint: Only SKILL.md is read from a .zip — scripts and other files are ignored, never executed.
import.name: Name

reason.not-skill-core: not part of the skill — not read

import.conflict: A skill with this name already exists — rename it to import.

delete.title: Delete skill?
delete.body: "{name}" will be deleted permanently, including its version history.
delete.usedBy: It is linked to {count, plural, one {# agent} other {# agents}} and will be unlinked:

saveVersion.title: Save v{from} → v{to}
saveVersion.subtitle: Name this version and review what changed since the last save.
saveVersion.versionTitleHint: Optional — shown in the Versions tab.
